name: Galio Sundae Patisserie
summary: A single bakery dressed as a pastry parlour in one colour family: every ground, band and plate is a tint of the chosen palette's hue (cherry by default), with white pages taking turns with tinted bands, Shrikhand over Outfit with Caveat script kickers. One shape language (circles, pills, 28px panels): a straight side rail in the family's near-black with rounded joins (a top bar and menu sheet on phones) and a scalloped awning only under each inner page's title; a hero slider of the best-selling collections, line-drawn collections, a mosaic of the real ways to get an order, a price list with dot leaders, best sellers on round plates with tilted stickers in the brand colour, the real counter on a map and the journal. Light by default, with a dark mode in the same family and a footer Theme row; switching the palette re-tints the whole page.
